slides.title: Title
slides.description: Opening slide on navy with the logo, the presentation title, a subtitle and the date.

slides.title: Agenda
slides.description: Five numbered sections, each with a one-line description.

slides.title: Section divider
slides.description: Navy divider with a large lime section number, the section title and a line of context.

slides.title: Executive summary
slides.description: Three key messages, each with a green marker, a headline and the evidence behind it.

slides.title: Text and callout
slides.description: An action title, two levels of bullets and a callout for the key takeaway.

slides.title: Two columns
slides.description: Two columns with headings and bullets, for options or periods side by side, and a recommendation.

slides.title: Key figures
slides.description: Four headline numbers on a navy band, the first in lime, with a note under each.

slides.title: Chart and text
slides.description: A native column chart in the BwB colours, ready for Edit Data, with a panel on what it shows.

slides.title: Table
slides.description: A data table with a navy header row, right-aligned figures and a total row.

slides.title: Process
slides.description: Four chevrons for the steps of a process, with the timing, activities and output of each.

slides.title: Two-by-two matrix
slides.description: Four quadrants on impact and feasibility, with the options plotted and listed.

slides.title: Timeline
slides.description: Six milestones on a line, grouped into phases, with the critical path below.

slides.title: Workplan
slides.description: A Gantt-style table of activities over twelve weeks, with deliverables marked.

slides.title: Icon grid
slides.description: Six items in a grid, each with a green Lucide icon, a title and a sentence.

slides.title: Image and text
slides.description: A photo from the BwB library beside a heading, bullets and a key point.

slides.title: Case study
slides.description: A navy panel naming the case, the challenge and the approach, and four results.

slides.title: Quote
slides.description: One quotation in Candara italic on a navy panel, with the speaker’s name and role.

slides.title: Team
slides.description: Four photo frames with names, roles and a short profile.

slides.title: Closing
slides.description: Navy closing slide with two contacts and the BwB website.

slides.title: Disclaimer
slides.description: The standard BwB disclaimer and the FCA note, in an off-white panel.
